mainText: Hello, Verona! At 11 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Over at Badger Ridge Middle School, we are experiencing overcast skies and a temperature of 59 degrees that feels more like 55. Tonight, the International Space Station will make an appearance at 8:29 PM, though you won't be able to see it due to the clouds.

Starting Wednesday, September 23, contractors will begin chip seal road treatments on Cross Country Road, East Verona Avenue, and within the Liberty Business Park. While roads remain open, expect temporary lane closures and traffic control. Street sweeping and line painting will follow.

There is plenty to do today, including the Sugar River Fire and Smoke BBQ Festival in Paoli, Bike the Barns at Badger Prairie County Park, and live music at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, check out Yoga at Insight Wellness, and look forward to trivia on Tuesday at Lake Lou-ee.

In the weekly recap, police reported that last Thursday, September 10, officers responded to an in-progress burglary on Hunters Cove Way where a shot was fired. A 19-year-old male was detained with a handgun and hospitalized for a severe window-cutting injury before being jailed.
Culvers is currently open until 10:00 PM today. However, please note that their scheduled flavor of the day is listed as closed today for remodeling.
